purpose: Precommit the first public non-synthetic optimizer workload before measuring evaluation outcomes or policy performance in this invocation.

workload.dataset: Breast Cancer Wisconsin Diagnostic via sklearn.datasets.load_breast_cancer
workload.dataset_kind: real tabular classification data bundled with scikit-learn; not a synthetic runtime generator
workload.candidate_order_seed_rule: episode seed independently permutes each family

budget_and_threshold_formulas.deadline_seconds: calibration direct-trace p75 of total time to success or full-family exhaustion, clipped to [1.0, 6.0] seconds
budget_and_threshold_formulas.static_percentile_switch_seconds: calibration p90 of direct time-to-success-or-exhaustion, clipped at deadline_seconds
budget_and_threshold_formulas.infeasible_override: switch immediately if empirical direct probability of success within remaining deadline falls below 0.35 and transversal probability exceeds it

decision_rule_for_interpretation: Do not call any policy universally superior. Report only this workload and exact seed split. A policy is a useful candidate if it improves success_by_deadline without worsening mean capped wall time by more than 10%, or reduces mean capped wall time by at least 10% without lowering success_by_deadline by more than 0.02 absolute. Otherwise record a mixed/null result.

requirements: restart must not duplicate a completed evaluation effect
restart must preserve the best-safe incumbent digest and restore pointer
forecast snapshot and switch decision must be durable before they can authorize an expensive alternative evaluation
in-flight evaluation must reconcile by stable evaluation identity before any retry

scope_limit: This workload tests switching/control behavior on one real bundled classification dataset and one pair of model families. It is not evidence for arbitrary optimizers, providers, hardware, or workloads.
